provider: SharePoint Online site collections (25 TB per site ceiling)

free_tier.stated: 25 TB maximum storage per site collection; 2,000,000 site collections per organization; 500,000 site collections per education tenant; file upload limit 250 GB.

egress.terms: Unmetered (same M365 subscription model - no per-GB egress meter).

tooling: Microsoft Graph (Sites.ReadWrite.All, Files.ReadWrite.All, app-only client-credentials flow); rclone 'onedrive' remote with drive_type=documentLibrary and a site/drive_id, or the SharePoint v2.0 endpoint override via tenant_url
chaining: This is the structural ceiling inside the A1 tenant: the pool is 100 TB, a single library can address 25 TB, and there are up to 2M sites. In a paid E3/E5 tenant (1 TB + 10 GB/license) the same 25 TB-per-site ceiling applies, so a 100-license tenant has 2 TB pooled but 50 sites worth of address space. Per-site ceilings only bind once you have the pool to back them.
limits_note: Bounded by the tenant pool, not by the site: a 100 TB-pool tenant holds at most 4 sites at 25 TB each. Versioning (50,000 major versions) silently multiplies storage on overwrite. Team sites force versioning on; standalone Communication sites allow 'No versioning'.
reliability_note: Version bloat is the real data-loss-adjacent hazard: re-uploading a 20 GB file to a Team site library can consume hundreds of GB of pool in hidden versions.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
